entries.subject: DAMIT 8131: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-8131.txt. Model 8131, version 2022-11-29, pole (327°, 66°), period 17.7464 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: NEOWISE Gr12b: selected thermal size
entries.finding: The original IRSA query was rerun for asteroid 1647; its Gr12b row matches the retained diameter 42.7160 km, error 0.5170 km, fit code DVBI and mean epoch 2455205.1766260. D in FIT_CODE means diameter was fitted. This effective-sphere diameter provides an approximate display scale, not a resolved surface or an independent physical-volume fit to the shape.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: The grid marks unmapped coverage: no registered global reflectance mosaic was found in the selected releases. Convex inversion leaves concavities and fine relief unresolved. - Transferring thermal diameter to mesh volume is approximate. The quoted fit error excludes additional thermal/shape uncertainty and does not measure local shape accuracy. - Elevation is false color for model radius minus a reference sphere, not gravitational height or independent terrain. - Absolute phase is arbitrary; accelerated display spin is illustrative. Orbit context is fixed at 2026-09-03 TT. The archive also lists an alternative pole. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 8132: pole (148°, 49°), 17.7466 h, version 2022-11-29. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Source mesh and calibration preservation
entries.finding: The [original mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/79848/shape.txt) is retained without changing its coordinates or connectivity. [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) supplies the coordinate units, pole and sidereal-period conventions; its CC BY 4.0 terms and other credits are linked from NOTICE.md.
